explanation: The statement is about `CoalgHom.codRestrict` for the library's own `Subcoalgebra` (Mathlib has no `Subcoalgebra` at all, and `CoalgHom.codRestrict` exists only in this library). I searched Mathlib for `codRestrict_unique`, `codRestrict_eq`, `eq_codRestrict`, `codRestrict_injective`, `codRestrict_inj`, and more generally for uniqueness-of-factoring statements through a subtype inclusion (e.g. in `Algebra/Module/Submodule/LinearMap.lean`, `Algebra/Algebra/Subalgebra/Basic.lean`, `Algebra/Star/Subalgebra.lean`, `Algebra/Star/NonUnitalSubalgebra.lean`, `ModelTheory/Substructures.lean`, `Data/Set/Restrict.lean`). Mathlib only has `subtype_comp_codRestrict`-style lemmas (the composite equals the original map) and injectivity lemmas for `codRestrict`, but nowhere a statement saying that any `g` with `subtype.comp g = f` equals the codomain restriction; so the result cannot be obtained from a single Mathlib declaration in one or two lines without redoing the argument (injectivity of `D.subtype.comp ·`).
